spokenMeaning: No matter what you do, someone will disapprove — the negative verdict isn't a response to your action, it's already there before you act.
viewerTakeaway: Approval-seeking is a rigged game: since the verdict arrives before the action, changing what you do can never change whether you're criticized.

visualNarrative.action: Left text block (headline + supporting lines) fades in; right side shows only a bare outlined stage rectangle on the dark bg.
visualNarrative.meaning: Nothing has been done yet — the space of action is empty and unjudged.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Empty 1px outlined rectangle sits right of the text block, interior completely blank.

visualNarrative.action: A red verdict stamp drops hard onto the EMPTY stage interior first, before any action exists, landing slightly rotated.
visualNarrative.meaning: The judgment is issued before any behavior occurs — the disapproval is not a response, it is the starting condition.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Red stamp badge with white 'VONIS' hits blank stage floor while no line is drawn anywhere in frame.

visualNarrative.action: A teal action line draws itself from the stage's left edge, runs right, and is pressed flat where it passes beneath the red stamp, stopping at it.
visualNarrative.meaning: Whatever you actually do arrives second and enters the frame already under the verdict.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Teal stroke draws left→right and flattens/clips exactly at the stamp's footprint, stamp sitting above it unchanged.

visualNarrative.action: A second, dimmer teal line draws on a different route (rises, curves around) but still terminates underneath the same unmoved stamp; stamp holds and the frame exits by fade.
visualNarrative.meaning: Changing the action does not move the verdict — no path escapes, so the whole approval-seeking strategy is rigged.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Two different teal paths both end under one identical red stamp that never shifts, lifts, or re-evaluates.

compositionIntent: leftTextRightObject: headline + supporting lines occupy the left ~38% with 8% margins, the right ~48% holds a single outlined stage. Red stamp is the only saturated mass, upper area of the stage; teal lines are thin strokes entering from lower-left of the stage. Roughly 60% negative space, no third cluster.
visualEvidence: Red stamp lands on a completely blank stage before any line exists in frame.
Teal action line flattens and stops exactly beneath the stamp's footprint.
Second teal path curves differently yet ends under the identical unmoved stamp.
'VONIS' and 'DULU' carry the only red type; all other text stays off-white.

noveltyIntent: Unlike memory's drift, bending and moving-target mechanisms, this reverses time itself: the red verdict stamps an empty stage before any action line is drawn, so unfairness reads as reversed causality rather than comparison.
